rationale.conceptual: The required outputs can be obtained by simply locating the numerical values in the paper (Table II and text) — no implementation of the crystal-field, rigid-ion, or mean-field model is actually needed to match the gold scores.
rationale.execution: Only two small CSV files with a handful of rows are produced; the reference solve.sh uses a simple bash script with hardcoded numbers, requiring no pipeline or tooling.

difficulty.reasoning: The task asks for a few numbers that are explicitly provided in the paper (elastic constants from Table II column 5, T=0 oxygen displacement of ~0.0039). The reference solution literally hardcodes these values without any computation. Thus, an agent can trivially pass by extracting the figures from the text; implementing the full theoretical model is unnecessary. Conceptual and execution difficulty are therefore minimal.

compute_estimate.reasoning: All calculations (if any) are analytical and operate on a few scalars; no data loading, training, or large-scale computation is required.
